purpose: Expected-return module, simplest rungs first: score next-session expected log return forecasts made at the previous close against an always-zero baseline. Past-only inputs, time-ordered expanding estimation, no learner, no threshold selection. Prediction scoring only; no allocation change, no orders, no profit claim.
how_this_differs_from_rejected_L: L used a 60-session label, LightGBM with many intraday features, yearly refits and quantile threshold selection. This draft uses a 1-session target, closed-form expanding moments only, no feature set beyond past adjusted closes/returns, no threshold, no learner.

source.returns: r[j] = log(C[j]/C[j-1]); 5937 returns 2002-10-15..2026-11-05 (same series and split as state-vol-v1)
source.evaluation_targets: predicted_for_session >= 2015-01-01 (2906 targets); calibration period is warm-up only, never scored

timing.decision_at: previous_session_close (logical marker): at close of session i, after C[i] is observed, emit mu_hat_i for session i+1 using only C[1..i] / r[1..i]
timing.predicted_for_session: i+1 = exact next session in the source day list
timing.target: y_i = r[i+1] = log(C[i+1]/C[i]) adjusted close-to-close log return (value_unit log_return, moment_order 1)
timing.usage_later: a separate pre-registered combine/allocate v2 would map (mu_hat_i, h_i) to w_i; not part of this run
timing.no_outcome_feedback: outcome records and scores never feed any predictor

P1_expanding_mean.estimates: 1 recursive moment per day, closed form, no optimizer

P2_ma200_conditional_mean.regime: s_i = 1 if C[i] > MA200_i (strict; MA over closes i-199..i), else 0; MA window 200 is a declared design constant inherited from ladder R2/R3, not tuned
P2_ma200_conditional_mean.mu_hat: expanding mean of r[j+1] over past j <= i-1 with s_j == s_i (next-day return given today's regime)
P2_ma200_conditional_mean.estimates: 2 conditional moments per day, closed form
P2_ma200_conditional_mean.fallback: if the regime has no past sample: mu_hat = 0 and count it (expected 0 after warm-up)

P3_ar1_expanding_optional.mu_hat: a_i + phi_i * r[i] with (a_i, phi_i) = expanding OLS over pairs (r[j], r[j+1]), j <= i-1
P3_ar1_expanding_optional.estimates: 2 closed-form OLS coefficients per day, no optimizer, no regularization choice
P3_ar1_expanding_optional.include: bill decides; market_model found phi ~ 0 in-sample, so this rung is expected to be near P1

metrics.primary: mean squared error of mu_hat against y over evaluation; paired difference variant minus P0, whole period and per calendar year
secondary_descriptive: mean(mu_hat * y) as directional covariance diagnostic (not PnL, no costs)
OLS slope and intercept of y on mu_hat (calibration, descriptive)
metrics.no_inference: no p-values or CI treating daily errors as independent
metrics.expected_scale: with daily sd ~1.5% and drift ~0.05%, even a perfect constant drift lowers MSE by ~0.1%; the run establishes the causal scoring pipeline, not a profit claim

outputs.envelope: contract v3: UTC artifact_id, parent_artifact_hashes [source, this spec] full, code/spec sha256, exchange_session KRX date sessions, availability_status, decision_at/execution_not_before markers, units
outputs.write: single xb write of the complete payload

verification_required: hand fixture (6 returns, MA window 2 for the test) asserting P1/P2/P3 closed forms and regime labels by hand
future perturbation: changing r[k+1..] leaves mu_hat for decision sessions <= k unchanged for every variant
regime uses closes through i only; strict inequality; MA undefined before 200 closes -> no prediction (warm-up only)
calibration/evaluation partition without overlap; no full-period moment anywhere
hashes checked before and after; selftest from the chat folder copy; single xb write
prohibited_in_this_run: choosing MA window, horizon, variant or fallback by looking at results
any future or full-period information (incl. demeaning with the full-period mean)
reusing the L LightGBM / 60-session / threshold pipeline
re-tuning allocation weights, bands or lambda
calling a lower MSE a trading edge
interpretation: All evaluation years already viewed; exploratory. Differences at the 0.1% MSE level are the expected scale. A better conditional-mean score is not established profitability; combining with the state and allocating is a later pre-registered step.
open_choices_for_bill: target: adjusted close-to-close r[i+1] (drafted, same series as state) vs raw open-to-open log(O[i+2]/O[i+1]) aligned with the allocation execution timeline
include P3 AR(1) now or stop at P2
P2 fallback when a regime has no past sample: 0 (drafted) vs P1 value
secondary 20-session cumulative target on non-overlapping blocks now or as a later rung
